nodes.title: Generating function for $r \times s$ rectangles in nondecreasing words

nodes.summary: The nondecreasing words of length $2$ over $[2] = \{1, 2\}$ are $11$, $12$ and $22$, which contain $1$, $1$ and $2$ rectangles of size $1 \times 2$ respectively, so the total number of $1 \times 2$ rectangles over all nondecreasing words of length $2$ over $[2]$ is $4$.
nodes.title: Example: $1 \times 2$ rectangles in nondecreasing words of length $2$

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$, $r$, $s$ and $n$, this is the sum, over all nondecreasing words $w_1 \le w_2 \le \cdots \le w_n$ of length $n$ over the alphabet $[k] = \{1, \dots, k\}$ (the set $W^{\nearrow}_{n,k}$), of the number of $r \times s$ rectangles in the bargraph of $w$.
nodes.title: Total number of $r \times s$ rectangles in nondecreasing words

nodes.summary: The bargraph of the word $345134$ contains exactly four rectangles of height $3$ and width $2$.
nodes.title: Example: $3 \times 2$ rectangles in the word $345134$

nodes.summary: Let $w = w_0 w_1 \cdots w_{m-1}$ be a word of natural numbers, drawn as a bargraph whose column $i$ has height $w_i$. The number of occurrences of an $r \times s$ rectangle (height $r$, width $s$) in $w$ is the number of pairs $(i, y)$ of natural numbers with $i < m$, $i + s \le m$ and $y \le w_0 + \cdots + w_{m-1}$ such that $y + r \le w_{i+j}$ for every $j < s$.
nodes.title: Number of $r \times s$ rectangles in a bargraph

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
